why_best: This decisive visual takeover creates a clean break in the narrative, giving the incoming broadcast graphic absolute priority over stale visual context.
why_bad: A soft blend or gradual dissolve would undermine the urgency of a news update, making the transition feel passive and indecisive.
trap: A subtle failure occurs if the underlying graphic panel moves away prematurely, exposing empty background rather than letting the new plate dominate it fully.
